answer.book: A single Latin panegyric oration (Steinberg, 1660, Leiden imprint) in honour of Count Ludovicus Henricus of Nassau, built as front matter (title page, dedication to the prince) followed by the continuous text of the oration, with no numbered parts, chapters or other internal divisions.

entries.title: Celsissime et illustrissime princeps Ludovice Henrice, Nassovius sanguis dignissimus, spes proxima et augusta patriæ, mu... Domine clementissime. Illustris et generosissime comes, sanguinis Solmensis traduX, et martio ardore inclute.
